decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith Drawing Numbers A-39HRCL-02B, 03B, 04B, 05B, 06B received 20/12/12.
Drawing Numbers 12-39HRCL-01A, 07A, Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment received 01/11/12.
and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted, including main building, porous path and terrace samples,  have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - Prior to commencement of this development, the applicant should submit further details and/or drawings showing the reprofiling of the embankment to ensure that stability will not be adversely affected.  In order to ensure the integrity and stability of the flood defences, the applicant will also need to demonstrate  that the new development will not place any additional or horizontal or vertical load upon the river wall, either temporarily or permanently. These details shall be submitted to, and approved by, the Local Planning Authority in writing, who approve in consultation with the Environment Agency.

Condition : 5 - The development shall not be occupied until details of the screen planting and general soft landscaping along side boundaries have been planted in accordance with a scheme submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the side elevations shall be tinted glazing and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with tinted glazing. A sample shall be submitted to an approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Construction of a new two-storey split level outbuilding at rear of garden towards the bottom of existing flood defence slope and a new wooden terrace to join existing terrace and the replacement of existing garden slope steps.
